paragraphs.text: The Amorites were on both sides of Jordan, of which two kings were slain already on the side toward Moab.

paragraphs.text: For they looked daily to move at the Lord's command, which they who were newly circumcised could not do without great danger.
paragraphs.label: d

paragraphs.text: For their sore was so grievous, that they were not able to move.
